solutions.title: Limited Bellman-Ford
solutions.strategy: Relax all flights for exactly k + 1 edge layers using a snapshot from the previous layer.

timeComplexity.explanation: For K = k + 1 allowed flight edges, each layer scans every flight once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only previous and current best-cost arrays are stored.

solutions.title: Stateful Dijkstra
solutions.strategy: Use a min-heap over cost, city, and edge count so cheaper states are expanded first within the stop budget.

timeComplexity.explanation: For K = k + 1 allowed flight edges, a city can have distinct useful costs per edge count.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The adjacency list, heap, and best table store per-stop states.
